definitions.gloss: old times, the past, long ago
definitions.explanation: A time in the distant past.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}、ここに{城|しろ}があった。
examples.english: Long ago, there was a castle here.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}の{友達|ともだち}に{会|あ}った。

notes: Used in storytelling: {昔々|むかしむかし} (once upon a time). Related: {昔話|むかしばなし} (folktale).
